name: io.github.iowarp/darshan-mcp
title: CLIO Darshan
description: Darshan I/O profiler MCP server for analyzing I/O trace files

tools.name: load_darshan_log
tools.description: Load and parse a Darshan log file to extract I/O performance metrics and metadata.

tools.name: get_job_summary
tools.description: Get job-level summary from a Darshan log including runtime, process count, and I/O volume.

tools.name: analyze_file_access_patterns
tools.description: Analyze file access patterns including read/write types and sequential vs random access.

tools.name: get_io_performance_metrics
tools.description: Extract I/O performance metrics including bandwidth, IOPS, and request sizes.

tools.name: analyze_posix_operations
tools.description: Analyze POSIX I/O operations including read/write system calls and their frequency.

tools.name: analyze_mpiio_operations
tools.description: Analyze MPI-IO operations including collective vs independent operations.

tools.name: identify_io_bottlenecks
tools.description: Identify I/O performance bottlenecks by analyzing access patterns and operations.

tools.name: get_timeline_analysis
tools.description: Generate timeline analysis showing I/O activity over time and temporal patterns.

tools.name: compare_darshan_logs
tools.description: Compare two Darshan log files to identify performance differences between runs.

tools.name: generate_io_summary_report
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive I/O summary report with findings and recommendations.

prompts.name: analyze_io_performance
prompts.description: Guided workflow for analyzing I/O performance from a Darshan log.
